methodology.scope: Matched individual analysts in the imported LBMA survey for gold, silver and platinum; one institution (EIA) for Brent, WTI and Henry Hub gas. This is not the full market of forecasters.
methodology.metric: Weighted mean absolute percentage error against the same asset’s documented annual-average benchmark. Lower is better; scores are not compared across assets.
methodology.selection: One fixed early-year forecast per forecaster per year, with all five completed years required. LBMA: annual survey; EIA: January STEO. Later revisions do not replace historical forecasts. Same analyst across employers; different analysts at the same institution are not merged.
limitations: Five annual observations is a small sample. Historical accuracy does not guarantee future accuracy.
Annual-average forecasts are not year-end targets, next-year forecasts or 3-month targets.
January submissions can observe some trading days in their target year.
2026 forecasts are the latest imported annual survey, not necessarily the latest report by that analyst.
LBMA 2026 describes a 12/13 January submission cutoff inconsistently; 13 January is retained as a conservative bound.
Benchmark actuals are reported rounded annual averages; no daily benchmark series is redistributed.
EIA latest imported forecast is September 2026. Its five-year score uses January vintages, not September predictions; one institution cannot establish a comparative winner.
EIA actuals use its annual historical spot tables reviewed 30 September 2026; historical revisions, aggregation and rounding can cause small differences from STEO table actuals.
